items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: Professor Blanchett lives right at the next corner here... He went to school with my husband, huh?

ctx.x: But usually, the soiree is just like we said before with the quadrille. You know, it's some parts that you really let your hand out. But the soiree dancin, we call it, that's our good time night. But of course, in a wonderful way. Because people come out to watch. I mean, it's a lot of fun. It really is. But in a nice way, of course. And then we have the tea.

Yeah. We begin our fiesta with a tea in September. We begin in September. Around the third Sunday, September? The third Sunday. In September. And it's always at the Autopilot club. They give us that date. The club, members of the club, give us the hall for that date. And, oh, we have a lovely tea. Tables are decorated, you know. And the board members are all in their regalia. Their big hats, flowers, and they serve at the tea tables. And we have, last year, we really almost had a concert. We had such nice…
I know he used to play with Perez, Manuel Perez, years ago.
